title: Rafael and the Thorn Anew
author: Mirabel Eastwick
blurb: Vesper Eastwick, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
